rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE BUREAU OF INTERNAL REVENUE TO MAKE PUBLIC TAX PAYMENTS OF INDIVIDUALS AND CORPORATIONS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 20 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: THE COMMISSIONER SHALL, ON OR BEFORE MAY 31 FOLLOWING THE CLOSE OF EACH CALENDAR YEARM PREPARE AND ALLOW PUBLICATION IN BOOK FORM A REPORT OF ALL INDIVIDUAL TAXPAYERS AS WELL AS BUSINESS ENTERPRISES WHICH HAVE FILED THEIR TAX RETURNS WITH THE BUREAUDURING THE YEAR. THE REPORT SHALL CONTAIN, BUT SHALL NOT BE LIMITED TO THE FOLLOWING: (1) TAXABLE INCOME; (2) NAME OF BUSINESS ENTERPRISE; (3) TYPE OF BUSINESS, CORPORATION, PARTNERSHIP, SOLE PROPRIETORSHIP; (4) GROSS SALES/RECEIPTS DURING THE YEAR;(5) AMOUNT OF TAXES PAID BY TYPE OF TAX; AND (6) PRESUMPTIVE INPUT TAX.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ABOLISHING THE RESERVE OFFICERS TRAINING CORPS (ROTC) AND CREATING ALTERNATIVE SOCIAL ACTION PROGRAMS IN SCHOOLS
rows.abstract: In lieu of the ROTC, all colleges and universities in the country, both public and private, shall include Social Action Programs as options in their academic curricula. The establishment of social action desks or institutes, in schools where there are none, shall be supervised by the school in direct coordination, with the active participation and meaningful consultation with the school's student councils, publications and organizations. If there are parallel SAPs already existing, reviews, direct coordination, active participation and meaningful consultations shall be held with the school's students councils, publications and organizations.

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE CAPABILITY OF THE BUREAU OF FOOD AND DRUGS (BFAD) BY ESTABLISHNG ADEQUATE TESTING LABORATORIES AND REGIONAL FIELD OFFICES, UPGRADING ITS EQUIPMENT, CREATION OF A DRUG ENFORCEMENT UNIT UNDER ITS OPERATIONAL AND ADMINISTRATIVECONTROL, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "BFAD Empowerment Act of 2001". Rationale: There is a need to transform Bureau of Food and Drugs (BFAD) into a more and credible regulatory agency, and to borrow the words of the UP Policy Review Team, one whose integrity and credibility are above reproach and if possible, beyond any reasonable doubt. To achieve, this it is vital, among other thinds not only to provide adequate funding for the agnecy but more importantly, introduce major administrative reforms in BFAD to strengthen the capability of BFAD's regulatory functions of licensing, registration and monitoring, and more specifically in the following aspects: (1) Human resources in the field; (2) Augmentation of existing laboratories and upgrading their equipment; (3) Operational buudget; and (4) Creation of a drug enforcement unit under its operational and administrative control.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05497

rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09164) enacted on 2002-03-19
rows.title_full: AN ACT POSTPONING THE BARANGAY ELECTIONS IN MAY 2002 TO THE SECOND MONDAY OF MAY 2004, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The regular elections in May 2002 for punong barangay, sangguniang barangay members and the sangguniang kabataan chairman shall be postponed to the second Monday of May 2004. Thereafter, regular elections for the said barangay officials shall be held every after four years. The incumbent punong barangay, sangguniang barangay members and sangguniang kabataan chairman shall continue to hold office until their successors are duly elected and qualified. > Should the scheduled barangay elecitons next year be reset to 2004, synchronized with the Presidential and local elections, the government will have more savings that could be spend for the construction of farm-to-market roads and/or for the purchase of automated ballot machines.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04456

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING THE COOPERATIVE CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES TO BE KNOWN AS THE `CODE OF PHILIPPINE COOPERATIVES OF 2001'
rows.abstract: After a decade, it is observed that the Code has not been fully implemented to the optimum benefit of the cooperatives movement due to some inconsistencies in the political and legal aspects of the law. It is for this reason that amendments to the Code should be made in order to enliven its constitutional precept, to wit: (1) By making registration requirements more affordable, attractive and convenient; (2) By upgrading the powers and capacities of cooperatives; (3) By providing adequate and clear tax incentives and privileges to cooperatives; and (4) By putting appropriate safeguards on the temptation to take advantage of leadership position for selfish purposes.

rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE TYPOLOGY OF PUBLIC HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS AND FOR OTHER RELATED PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Public Higher Education Typology Act of 2001". The term "TYPOLOGY OF PUBLIC HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS" shall mean the main classifications of state colleges and universities into pre-university and university institutions. It is further categorized into: (1) agricultural; (2) polytechnic/tec hnological; (3) normal or comprehensive college or university. Rationale: Here in the Philippines, the distinction between colleges and universities is blurred. Furthermore, the distinction between polytechnics, agricultural and comprehensive colleges is unclear. Thus, there is a need to distinguish the typology or classification by characteristics of our higher academic institutions. > This measure proposes to define and classify public higher edducaiton institutions so as to make the allocation of government resources more rationale and equitable.

rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROVISION GUARANTEEING EQUAL ACCESS TO OPPORTUNITIES FOR PUBLIC SERVICE
rows.abstract: Rationale: Until date, however, equal access to opportunities for public service has remained a promise unfulfilled. The equally qualified potential appointees of Visayas and Mindanao have always been discriminated of appointments invital offices ofgovernment. >This bill provides that "As far as practicable, all other officials and employees shall likewise be recruited proportionately from the provinces and cities of their origin."
